en.title: D.M.A
en.decryption: The 'Big Three' Indo-Greeks: Demetrius (The Pioneer), Menander (The Scholar-King), and Apollodotus (The Expander).

hi.title: D.M.A
hi.decryption: The 'Big Three' Indo-Greeks: Demetrius (The Pioneer), Menander (The Scholar-King), and Apollodotus (The Expander).

fact.en: Do not confuse Indo-Greeks with the Indo-Scythians (Sakas); Indo-Greeks minted the first gold coins in India, not the Kushans.
fact.hi: Do not confuse Indo-Greeks with the Indo-Scythians (Sakas); Indo-Greeks minted the first gold coins in India, not the Kushans.

fact.en: Menander was not an immediate convert to Buddhism; the 'Milinda Panha' records a dialogue leading to his intellectual leaning, not necessarily total conversion.
fact.hi: Menander was not an immediate convert to Buddhism; the 'Milinda Panha' records a dialogue leading to his intellectual leaning, not necessarily total conversion.

fact.en: The Gandhara School of Art is a result of fusion, not purely Greek.
fact.hi: The Gandhara School of Art is a result of fusion, not purely Greek.
